speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. You are presenting with wrist pain, fever, and skin lesions. To begin our investigation, have you recently traveled to a tropical region or been bitten by an insect?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient presents with a 3-day history of pain in his left wrist, which worsened this morning accompanied by chills and malaise. He recounts having a self-resolving left knee pain the previous week. Reports recent return from a camping trip in Minnesota. Sexually active with one female partner. No history of trauma to the wrist.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Septic Arthritis of the Left Wrist (likely caused by *Neisseria gonorrhoeae* given the sexual history and monoarticular presentation). The recent knee pain represents a prior episode of gonococcal arthritis, and the travel history to Minnesota is a red herring. I am requesting your blood work and imaging results to confirm.

REQUEST TEST: CBC, ESR, CRP, Blood Cultures, Synovial Fluid Analysis, Urine NAAT for Gonorrhea.
REQUEST IMAGES: X-Ray Left Wrist, Ultrasound Left Wrist.
